COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
CRLR No.309 of 2021
Hon'ble R.C. Khulbe, J.
 Mr. D. C. S. Rawat, learned counsel for the
revisionist.
 Mr. A. K. Shah, learned Dy. A. G. for the
State.
 Mr. Maneesh Bisht, learned counsel for the
private respondent no. 2.
This criminal revision is preferred against the
judgment and order dated 08.10.2021 passed by
Judge, Family Court Kotdwara, District Pauri
Garhwal in Misc. Criminal Case No.85 of 2018
"Gulshan Begum vs. Amruddin, whereby the
concerned Court allowed the application filed under
Section 125 Cr.P.C and awarded Rs.6000/- per
month as maintenance to respondent no.2 against
the revisionist.
Learned counsel for both the parties are
present before the Court.
Learned counsel for the revisionist fairly
submitted that the revisionist is ready to pay
Rs.5000/- per month instead of Rs.6,000/- per
month as awarded by the concerned Court.
 Learned counsel for the respondent has no
objection to the same.
Accordingly, on the joint request, the revision
is partly allowed and the order dated 08.10.2021
passed by the Court below is modified to the extent
that the revisionist will pay Rs.5000/- per month to
the respondent no.2 as maintenance, instead of
Rs.6,000/-, as awarded by the Court below.
The revision is disposed of in the above
terms.
Pending application, if any, stands disposed
of.
 (R.C. Khulbe, J.)
 16.12.2021
R.Bisht
